description: This file defines a React functional component named LiveVitals, which renders a live-updating heart rate chart simulation using the Recharts library. It includes UI controls for controlling simulation speed, window size, and start/stop functionality. The component manages state for synthetic heart rate data generation and visualization, making it a self-contained client-side demo of streaming data visualization.

methods.name: generateNext
methods.description: Generates the next simulated heart rate data point with sinusoidal variations and random noise.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the running state of the simulation between start and pause.

methods.name: onSpeedChange
methods.description: Handles change in simulation speed from user input.

methods.name: onWindowChange
methods.description: Handles change in the sliding window size for the chart.
